ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_WITHDRAWAL_D: Your first formal card next turn costs {Amount} more.
ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_MOMENTUM_REM: Whenever you Exhaust a card, deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.
ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_ESCALATING_P: Whenever you Exhaust a card, gain {Amount} Block.

ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_SERPENT_DANC: Whenever you switch between an Attack and a Skill, deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.
ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_APPROACHING_: Whenever Control triggers this turn, its card costs {Amount} less this turn.
ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_SNAKE_WALK_P: Whenever you switch between an Attack and a Skill this turn, gain {Amount} Block.
ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_PAIN_TAMING_: Unblocked damage does not reduce Excitement.

ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_TAMING_EXHIB: Whenever Control triggers, deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.

ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_ENDLESS_DANC: At the start of your turn, put [gold]Slithering Serpent[/gold] on top of your Draw Pile. After you automatically play a derived card, gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] to strengthen your next attack.

ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_DEADLY_FLEXI: Generated Slithering Serpents become Viper's Kisses.
ARABELLA_MOD_POWER_ARABELLA_DISCARD_PLEA: Exhausting a card filters your hand.
